name: progress
description: Progress bar with animated fill, color variants, and an optional percentage label

changes.note: The value can come without an inline style. New prop data-value (0–100, a percentage) on the root sets the fill width in pure CSS: whole 5 % steps in every engine, any number exactly where typed attr() is supported, clamped to the track, and an unparseable value draws an empty bar rather than a full one. A server template, which rightly refuses data in a style attribute, renders data-value instead; the reference markup and templates.html now use it. The style="width: …" form on the fill still works and wins when both are present.

Nested components keep their own parts. The track, fill and label rules were descendant selectors. label is a common part name, so anything nested in a bespoke progress indicator with a label of its own took this component's label size, colour and reserved width. They are child chains now (root > track > fill, root > label), with the track hop in :where() so no rule changes specificity.

Render the percentage label in every canonical visual variant, reserve four characters plus an inline-end inset for 100%, give the progressbar an accessible name, and complete the reference's visual-variant set. The label remains an explicitly optional slot for bespoke progress indicators.

fill.description: Filled portion. Its width comes from data-value on the root (pure CSS, no style attribute), or from an inline style or reactive binding on the fill, which wins when both are present

label.description: Optional visible text showing the current percentage or status; when present, sized to keep 100% fully inside the root

value.description: The value as a percentage, 0–100, on the root; sets the fill width with no inline style. Whole multiples of 5 render in every engine; any other number renders exactly where typed attr() is supported and as an empty bar elsewhere, so round to 5 when the page must look the same everywhere. Keep aria-valuenow and the label text in step with it

templates.html: {value}%

safe_transforms: Change data-variant to any listed variant
Change data-size to any listed size
Update data-value (or the fill's width) with the matching aria-valuenow and label text
Add or remove the label slot
tests: Every variant renders track fill and label
data-value sets the fill width without an inline style
Labels stay fully within the root including 100 percent
